Demo sample: data/sample-dec-page-northstar.txt (Northstar renewal $1,488/6mo = $248/mo, +18%).

data.text: In-browser calls (web pages simulating phone conversations where the agent talks aloud and a person responds via microphone) hang indefinitely if there's no receiver page assigned to answer them. Root cause of health negotiation hang: call was created with no receiver page to ring (only auto policies have receiver pages at /demo/receiver/1-3). Solution: block negotiations on non-auto policies (health, renters, etc) to prevent creating unreachable calls. This is an architectural issue, not a timing issue; timeout won't help.

evidence: The call was created as an in-browser call with **no phone page to ring**. The receiver page is the only thing that can answer these calls, so nothing could ever pick it up. It sat at "dialing" forever... only the auto policy has receiver phones assigned.

data.text: Leon proposes adding validation to POST /api/agents/launch to prevent hanging browser calls with no assigned receiver. The validation would check that targets array is non-empty and each target has a phone or email broker.
